scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplies infinite statements. Reproducible symbolic, integration and simulation checks are illustrative diagnostics, not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Two-level real symmetric operator, independent Haar-uniform trial vector and iid Gaussian sketch; exact arithmetic; fixed multiplicities for k-asymptotics. Extending to general spectra and finite-precision solvers is unproved. The Gaussian quotient identity is classical; independent publication-priority validation is outstanding.
title: Multiplicity controls spectral-envelope escape for Gaussian-sketched Rayleigh quotients
